title: INVOL (REACC) ? VOL (Pre-Move, -ve Earlier) � Negative VOL NOT Deducted (Customer Mitigating)
description:
System auto-rebooked via REACC (INVOL) to arrival 18:00, then customer voluntarily changed to an EARLIER flight via Pre-Move (-ve VOL) arriving at 15:00. The customer is mitigating by going earlier � negative VOL is NOT deducted. Full delay from promise (10:00) to actual (15:00) = 5hrs is used. Validates that negative VOL (customer mitigation) is never penalized.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Alain Bouchard); 1 leg AC YUL?YYZ; Original (14-day) arrival: 10:00; Change 1 (D-3): REACC (MUC1A06AC) ? new arrival 18:00; Change 2 (D-2): Pre-Move VOL (RF-PMV / YMQAC0848) ? customer goes EARLIER, new arrival 15:00 (-3hrs from REACC result); Actual arrival: 15:00; Code: 42 (Controllable); 72 hrs elapsed; No duplicate; Not employee; Not infant
